primary_title: Plexins are a large family of receptors for transmembrane, secreted, and GPI-anchored semaphorins in vertebrates; Structural basis of Semaphorin-Plexin recognition and viral mimicry from Sema7A and A39R complexes with PlexinC1
decision_basis: The semaphorin reviews cite the plexin-family primary study identifying Plexin-C1 as the receptor for GPI-anchored SEMA7A, with subsequent structural binding support.

primary_title: Semaphorin 7a promotes spreading and dendricity in human melanocytes through beta1-integrins; Semaphorin 7A promotes axon outgrowth through integrins and MAPKs
decision_basis: The semaphorin literature cites the primary melanocyte study showing SEMA7A uses beta1-integrins as a ligand/receptor context and that beta1-integrin blockade changes SEMA7A-dependent spreading and dendricity.
limitations_preserved: ITGB1 is an integrin subunit and may represent multiple beta1 heterodimers; preserve heterodimer/cell-context boundary and do not infer an autonomous ITGB1 relay.
